scope: Published adult image diagnostics; no clinical calibration

source.adult_status: Article cohort is 20–30 years; caption identifies an adult example
source.use: Temporary local measurement and software debugging; no training or image redistribution

detector: MediaPipe Python FaceLandmarker 1.1.0, official float16 model v1, CPU
renderer: Actual simulationPipeline.js using Canvas 2D via @napi-rs/canvas; not a browser or iPhone validation
interpretation: Residuals compare exploratory 2D ratios across two follow-ups of one person. They are not a clinical accuracy percentage and were not used to fit effect magnitudes.
limitations: The article blurs the eye regions; automatic alignment anchors are inferred and cannot be visually verified.
Low-resolution published panels and photographic variability limit measurement reliability.
Two follow-ups are one independent person, not two independent cases.
No product dose or generic intensity level has been matched to the clinical treatment.
A 2D lip ratio is not 3D volume; detected lower-lip ratio changes disagree in direction with the preview, requiring better images and independent manual review.
math_fixes_applied: Initialize filler-product settings before they are used; previously lip simulations raised a ReferenceError.
Measure visible upper/lower vermilion thickness instead of the gap between the lips.
Account for image proportions and mouth-axis orientation in lip anatomy weighting.

excluded_sources.reason: Cropped lower face with measurement overlays; both panels did not yield a detectable face.
Duplicate presentations of one cropped lip pair; both clean panels did not yield a detectable face; Figure 3 contains a surface overlay.
Side profile cannot be compared with frontal FaceMesh ratio metrics.
CC BY-NC-ND source excluded before acquisition.
Further image acquisition rejected by automatic approval review because the study includes minors; no images acquired or analyzed from this study.
